steps.code:
# Parse all notes to extract date and habit values
import re

habits_order = None
rows = []

for note in notes_data:
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    m = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', note['title'])
    if not m:
        continue
    date_str = m.group(1)
    # Parse content lines
    content_lines = [line.strip() for line in note['content'].split('\n') if line.strip() and ':' in line]
    habit_values = {}
    for line in content_lines:
        parts = line.split(':', 1)
        if len(parts) == 2:
            habit = parts[0].strip()
            value = parts[1].strip().lower()
            habit_values[habit] = value
    # Determine habits order from first note
    if habits_order is None:
        habits_order = [line.split(':', 1)[0].strip() for line in content_lines]
    rows.append({'date': date_str, 'values': habit_values})

# Print first few rows to verify
print(rows[0])
print(habits_order)
